inKin gathers data from most wearables and health apps available on the market. And we strive to launch more engaging features to help you and your teams build new habits, reduce stress, improve your overall wellbeing, and, ultimately, live a happier.

In your journey with inKin, we recommend using our top-rated features: Habit-Builder, Task-Based challenges, Group Challenges, and Team-Battles.

Creating an efficient and engaging corporate wellness program can require time and effort. That's why we have built our platform to make launching corporate wellbeing initiatives easier and more fun.

NEWS FEED - exchange ideas or recipes and share any health-related information with your peers.

STATS - your team's overall progress over the desired period or even two periods.

CHALLENGES & COMPETITIONS: create and join various public and private contests.
Challenge – a participant is required to reach either a daily or total goal during a certain period. A participant completes the challenge once he or she meets the requirements. This mode is available for one of these metrics: steps, distance, calories burned, activity time, and sleep.
Competition – the participant who reaches the highest metric (steps, calories burned, distance, activity time) wins the contest.
Team Battle – a competition between an unlimited number of teams. The mode is available for steps, distance, calories burned, activity time.
Group Challenge - allows all participants to reach one goal together. This mode is available for one of these metrics: steps, distance, calories burned, activity time
Task-Based Challenge - allows tracking up to 15 metrics and tasks simultaneously.

DATA EXPORT - export your team's overall progress and contests' results data in CSV files.


2. Individuals

SUPPORTED DEVICES & APPS: Apple (HealthKit app), Fitbit, Garmin, Polar, Samsung, Withings, iHealth, Google Fit, Misfit

YOUR HEALTH AND FITNESS STATS: collect your health and fitness data from fitness devices and apps or log it manually. View your customized charts, graphs and widgets to help you monitor your progress towards healthier you.

HABIT BUILDER
A simple and efficient tool to develop good habits and quit the bad ones.

GOALS: we support 20 fitness and health parameters. Set goals to help you stay focused on your progress.

DUELS - 24-hour head-to-head step challenges with other community members.

GET SOCIAL
Support your friends on their fitness journey with likes and comments.
Find new fitness buddies in your local community and across the world.

PRIVACY & SHARING: it is entirely up to you who you want to share your fitness and health data with – our customized settings allow you to share different metrics with certain friends and family.

Team Shake provides a technological and environmentally friendly way to choose teams for board games, sporting events, tournaments, school projects or anytime groups are required. The newest release brings many new features including full iPad support, balancing teams based on skill or gender, importing users from a file, enabling video output, and sharing teams via facebook or email. 

Team Shake is the premier iOS App for creating teams. Instead of a hat and scraps of paper, the user enters his friends' names in his iPhone and gives it a shake. The screen will then display a random set of color-coded teams. These teams can immediately be used for game play or shared via facebook or email.   The quick and easy selection of random (or balanced) teams eliminates fighting over who will be on which team. Innovative use of the iPhone shake gesture gives users the satisfying feeling of shaking a virtual hat without the trouble of carrying around an actual hat. Conventional buttons can also be used for those who would rather not shake their expensive hardware about.  

The app is designed with ease of use and simplicity in mind. Names can easily be entered with the onscreen keyboard, chosen from the user's contacts, or imported from a file. The email and facebook functions document the members of each individual team as well as preserving the team number and color assigned by the app. For repeated use of Team Shake, lists of friends can be easily saved and loaded later. The current list is also automatically saved so that if you exit the app, or even reboot the device, changes will not be lost. For teachers and others with large lists of people, Team Shake supports the ability to import teams from text or csv files.

results.description:
Key function
————————
With this app, the teacher can quickly form small groups of students to perform cooperative assignments.

How it works
————————
To form peer groups, you need to select a class, and then the size of the group. For example, 2 people, or 3, or 4, etc. After that, the application will automatically divide students into small groups and show their names on the phone screen.

Notes
————————
Groups are formed in random order.

First, It needs enter the names of the classes and the names of the students into the program.

Discussion: Why is this necessary?
————————
Uniting students into groups for joint work is one of the progressive educational technologies. By completing various educational tasks together with peers, students acquire not only educational knowledge, but also the experience of communicating with other people, the experience of joint search and acquisition of new knowledge.

Moreover, a number of studies show that knowledge and skills at the first stage exist in the form of communication between people, and then are transformed into an individual experience of the individual.

Various criteria can be used to create cooperative groups. Most often this is a random choice, when students come together in groups to gain experience of working with different peers. For example, a teacher asks students to name numbers in order from 1 to 3, then everyone with number 1 is grouped into the first group, students with number 2 are grouped into the second group, etc.

Also, groups can unite students with the same or, conversely, different levels of training in the subject (for example, programming, English, mathematics, etc.), with the same or different first language of communication, etc.

The sizes of small groups depend on the content of the tasks being solved. Most often, groups of 2, 3 or 4 people are created, less often 5 or more.

More complex criteria or procedures for creating cooperative groups also require more time to prepare them (for example, to assess the level of training), as well as to carry them out.

The Teacher Group Maker app automates this routine and allows the teacher to create small groups within a class based on a random selection literally within seconds.

At the beginning of the term, the teacher can enter the names of the classes with which he will work, as well as the names of the students. Then, during the lesson , he can quickly form small groups, varying their size.

Conclusion
————————
The Teacher Group Maker app takes another step towards improving the education system through the use of new high technology.

The target audience
————————
The application is addressed to teachers and instructors of schools, colleges and universities.

Dedicated to
————————
The developer dedicates this application to teachers of Mt Hood Community College (Gresham, OR).

I was happy to take Swift programming classes at this college using a curriculum kindly provided by Apple company.

HOW IT WORKS
Create a "Pakt" — a 7, 14, or 21-day challenge in a category like fitness, reading, nutrition, studying, or anything you define yourself. Invite your friends to join. Every day, everyone submits photo or video proof that they followed through. Miss a day, and you're out.

STAY ACCOUNTABLE, TOGETHER
Unlike solo habit trackers that are easy to abandon, Pakt makes your progress visible to the people who matter. Your friends see your proof. You see theirs. Nobody wants to be the one who quits first.

AI-VERIFIED PROOF
Every proof you submit is automatically checked to make sure it's real and relevant — no faking your way through the challenge.

PEER REVIEW & DISPUTES
In group challenges with 3+ members, your friends can approve or question your proof. If something looks off, a dispute can be opened and resolved by group vote — keeping everyone honest.

REAL CONSEQUENCES, REAL FUN
Set a penalty for anyone who gets eliminated an Instagram story confession or a voice message to the group. It's social pressure that actually works, with a sense of humor.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
See your streaks, your completion rate, and your personal stats at the end of every Pakt. Share your results with a beautifully designed card.

WHY PAKT WORKS
Building a habit alone is hard. Building it with people who will actually notice if you stop? That's how real change happens.
